in_arabic.name: فاطم
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطم هو اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي فطم، الذي يعني انقطاع الحلم أو الخصوبة، و هو اسم بنت النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، و يعتبر من الأسماء المقدسة في الإسلام، و يرمز إلى الخصوبة و النعمة الإلهية

in_urdu.name: فاطم
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطم ایک عربی نام ہے جو فطم سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خیر و برکت کی علامت ہے، اور یہ نام نبی محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم کی صاحبزادی کا ہے، جو اسلام میں بہت مقدس ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़ातिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ातिम एक अरबी नाम है जो फ़त्म से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है समृद्धि और आशीर्वाद, और यह नाम नबी मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम की पुत्री का है, जो इस्लाम में बहुत पवित्र है

in_pashto.name: فاطمه

in_english.name: Fatim

data.cultural_impact: The name Fatimah is of Arabic origin and is one of the most revered and beloved names among Muslims. It is said that Fatimah bint Muhammad, the beloved Prophet's daughter, was the embodiment of beauty, grace, and intelligence. Her name continues to be a popular choice among Muslim parents, and she is often referred to as "Mother of the Believers." Fatimah's legacy extends beyond her immediate family and her impact can be seen in the rich Islamic art, literature, and architecture that reflects the deep love and reverence Muslims have for her.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Fatimah is considered a model of purity, devotion, and submission to Allah. Her life serves as an inspiration for Muslims to strive for excellence in their faith, character, and deeds. Fatimah's steadfastness and self-sacrifice, particularly during her husband Imam Ali's imprisonment and his eventual martyrdom, demonstrate her unwavering commitment to truth and justice. Her deep love and devotion to her father Prophet Muhammad, who is considered the last messenger of Allah, demonstrate her unwavering obedience to Allah's Commandments. Her legacy continues to inspire Muslims to foster a wholesome character, based on faith, knowledge, love, and service to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Daughter" symbolizes The one who has given birth to a beautiful daughter. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fatim serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of daughter.
